title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controller Preorders Cause Chaos
description: Pre-orders for the new GTA 6 PS5 controllers went live this morning, causing severe traffic overload on PlayStation's store and immediate scalper resales on eBay.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Spark Massive Preorder Chaos

The hype surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 reached a new hardware level this morning as pre-orders officially went live for the game's new limited-edition PlayStation 5 controllers. According to reports from IGN Games, the entire release experience turned out to be extremely chaotic for eager fans trying to secure their hardware.

As one of the most anticipated entertainment releases in history, any official merchandise tied to GTA 6 is bound to generate intense demand. The sudden rush of players attempting to lock in their pre-orders overwhelmed the PlayStation store's infrastructure, leading to widespread congestion and long digital queues. Many fans took to online forums to express their frustration over the unstable checkout experience.

## Scalpers Rapidly Move to eBay With Resales

True to form for major hardware launches in the modern gaming landscape, scalpers were quick to capitalize on the limited availability. Shortly after the chaotic pre-order window opened this morning, listings for the GTA 6 PS5 controllers began appearing on third-party resale platforms like eBay at inflated prices.

This rapid turnaround by scalpers has sparked renewed discussions within the gaming community regarding online queue fairness and stock protection. Genuine fans who struggled through the overloaded store pages now face the daunting task of competing against automated bots and opportunistic resellers.

## Editor's Take

The chaotic rollout of the GTA 6 PS5 controllers highlights the sheer magnitude of the game's cultural footprint, but it also underscores ongoing issues with retail infrastructure and scalper exploitation. Platforms need to implement stricter anti-scalping measures to ensure that passionate players can actually buy limited-edition hardware at standard retail prices.
